description: This is a PHP class file that defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams, a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and manages filtering parameters such as employee number and immigration record number.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field to 'eir.number'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number as an integer.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the immigration record number, which may be null.
